title: Development of a bio-based adhesive by polymerization of Boc-protected vinyl catechol derived from caffeic acid
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, 3,1714-1720
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00629A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shiho Tanizaki, Tomohiro Kubo, Yosuke Bito, Shigeki Mori, Hiroyuki Aoki, Kotaro Satoh
Catechol polymers enabled the preparation of a biomimetic adhesive using a bio-based raw material, in which the deprotection proceeded just upon heating with neither any solvent nor catalyst, releasing only gaseous byproducts without purification.
